summary: The Platform Group, the owner of specialized marketplaces across dozens of categories, is buying back up to 5 million euros of its own bonds. The move is notable, as several creditors are reportedly seeking repayment of tens of millions of euros from the company. German business magazine Manager Magazin recently…
